company.what_they_do: web-library.net is a public email/inbox service — not a company or product organization. It provides free, publicly accessible email addresses to anyone who signs up. The homepage explicitly describes it as a 'public email service' focused on spam prevention. Despite self-claiming it is 'not a throwaway email service,' the nature of freely issued public email addresses (anyone can create one with any name) makes it functionally indistinguishable from a disposable/temporary email provider.
company.raw_notes: Homepage text presents web-library.net as a public email platform. Key flags: (1) No real company behind the domain — it is itself an email provisioning service, not a business that would use email to sign up for B2B tools. (2) The org_name 'AdaSecTestCo' is clearly synthetic/fabricated — contains 'Test' in the name, strongly suggesting a test or probing signup. (3) The email prefix 'polytest6482656' contains 'test' and a long random numeric string, a classic pattern for automated/bot signups. (4) The homepage explicitly asks services NOT to block their domain, a common tactic used by disposable email providers to stay on allowlists. (5) No real business entity, no products, no team, no about page — purely an email relay/inbox service. (6) Abuse reporting via ticket system mentioned, consistent with a public inbox service that has ongoing abuse issues.
